item.title: Construction of Olive Street housing project homes in Mahomets Flats set to be completed in mid-2026
item.description: One of the biggest critics of the Olive Street housing project concedes there is no point protesting while they are being built, but has not ruled out launching a bid for the council to offload them in future.

item.title: Police issue public appeal after two men seen with gun at Meekatharra mining camp
item.description: Police are appealing for the public’s help as they investigate an encounter at a mining camp, in which some people were seen armed with a gun.

item.title: Fire emergency, power outage and lotto windfall among Geraldton Guardian’s most viewed Facebook posts of 2025
item.description: The top 10 most popular posts on the Geraldton Guardian’s Facebook page for 2025 attracted a massive audience of more than 1.7 million views combined.

item.title: City of Greater Geraldton opens up next round of grant applications, as successful recipients are announced
item.description: Community groups as diverse as historical societies and equestrian clubs have come out as winners in the latest round of grants from the City of Greater Geraldton.

item.title: Geraldton teenager Sarah Kenyon to rely on hometown knowledge in Junior World Wave Grand Final
item.description: If there’s anyone who knows the waves and wind of Geraldton’s shores, it’s windsurfing junior girls world number one Sarah Kenyon.

item.title: Geraldton finalising country week side, as it prepares to launch title defence
item.description: Geraldton’s teams for the CSBP Men’s and Women’s Country Week Championships, played in Perth and starting on January 18, are close being finalised.

item.title: What I See with Peter Fiorenza: The special kind of bond that exists between dogs and their owners
item.description: My border collies Billie and Joel turned five years old the other day. My little fur babies are all grown up, considering they are supposed to be 35 in dog years.

item.title: Peter Papadellis: 25-year-old man accused over fatal assault on Mark Beaver in Geraldton granted bail
item.description: The 25-year-old man accused over the fatal assault on well-known Geraldton business owner Mark Beaver has been granted bail and is likely to fight the allegation at trial, a court has been told.

item.title: Tathra wind farm project in Mid West takes next step with Environmental Protection Authority approval
item.description: A proposal for WA’s largest wind farm is one step closer to being approved, with the State’s Environmental Protection Authority opting not to assess it any further.

item.title: Kenneth John Giles: Police drop bombshell firearm licence revelation about accused Mullewa gunman
item.description: Kenneth John Giles is suspected of shooting a woman in the hand near Mullewa and fleeing the scene, with police still hunting for the accused gunman.
